accessExpiredHint: Verify the original email address or phone number again to receive a new link. Registration is not required.

attachmentCountExceeded: A reply can include up to 20 attachments.

attachmentTotalTooLarge: All attachments on this inquiry must total 200 MiB or less.
categoriesEmpty: No inquiry categories are currently available
categoriesLoadFailed: Inquiry categories are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
challengeUnavailableDescription: This verification provider cannot be completed on this page. Try again later or ask the site operator to check its configuration.
closeConfirm: Confirm that the problem is solved and close this presales inquiry?

createHint: Verify an email address or phone number before describing your question. The internal team is assigned automatically and is never exposed.
customFieldsInvalid: Check the required fields and formats in Additional information.
customFieldsLoadFailed: Additional information could not be loaded. Refresh before continuing verification.

destinationPlaceholder: Enter an email address or phone number
destinationRequired: Enter the email address or phone number that will receive the code and access link
linkDeliveryUncertain: The access-link delivery result is not yet confirmed

ratingLowHint: Reopen this inquiry if you still need help.

restartHumanCheck: Complete a new human check for another code
subject: Subject
submissionUnknown: The submission result is not confirmed

submittedHint: The access link is sent only to the verified destination and is never exposed on this page.
